source.description: PROBLEM: xt claude writes <WORKTREE>/.claude/settings.local.json with a path to the branch's tracked .xtrm/hooks/statusline.mjs, which can be stale; current methodology is global-only and Claude inherits the global statusLine. SUCCESS: launcher no longer writes worktree settings.local.json statusLine; global setup remains via claude-runtime-sync ensureGlobalStatusLine; docs/worktrees.md accurately describes behavior; regression coverage prevents reintroduction. SCOPE: cli/src/utils/worktree-session.ts and docs/worktrees.md, plus focused test if existing suite supports it. NON_GOALS: change global sync; change hooks; alter other launcher overrides; no release. CONSTRAINTS: smallest diff; preserve skill/specialist scaffolding; global path remains ~/.xtrm/hooks/statusline.mjs; no merge without review. VALIDATION: targeted worktree/CLI tests, docs checks, source grep proves no local statusline write; report exact paths. OUTPUT: branch + PR ready for review. SCRUTINY: MEDIUM.
source.title: Use global-only Claude statusline in xt worktrees
